title: Auto-enqueue multiformat pipeline output into post-queue after each run
rationale: queue-fill-real.ts (Sprint 1463) was a one-time backfill. Tomorrow's pipeline runs (05:00, 09:00 cron) will produce new videos that still won't auto-appear in post-queue. Fix: add inline queue-fill logic at end of runPipeline() in run-multiformat-pipeline.ts. After each successful run, new video_ids are checked against existing queue and appended with status=pending. Zero impact on dry-run mode. Added readFileSync to imports.
success_criteria: After pipeline run, successful video_ids appended to post-queue.jsonl
Existing video_ids in queue are not duplicated
No TypeScript compile errors in modified file

tasks.description: run-multiformat-pipeline.ts: add post-queue append block after successCount > 0 at end of runPipeline()
